verdict.rationale: First-party docs cover every mode the story names. Sub-agents are background runs that parallelize research and long tasks without blocking the main run. Swarm orchestrates many concurrent sub-agents from Code Mode scripts, with bounded fan-out, structured results and live progress. An A2A 1.0 JSON-RPC channel lets external agents submit tasks, and teams of specialist agents and multi-agent routing are also documented. A community user reports running 9 agents from one machine, but that speaks to concurrent agents rather than real work being split and parallelized. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that sub-agents or swarms actually split and parallelize real work.
